title: Read only the publication members an export capture needs, instead of the whole published snapshot
outcome: Read only the publication members an export capture needs, instead of the whole published snapshot
acceptance: During export, the publication-member fallback (storage/work/task_sync/origin.rs published_snapshot_member, called from ledger/publication_members.rs per item) first collects the work ids whose documents the capture actually needs, then reads only those documents from the confirmed publication commit in one Git batch; it no longer reads every document of the published snapshot
A behaviour test with a large published snapshot and few needed members counts documents read (only the needed ones) and Git process starts (constant, the same at N=2 and N=200 needed members)
Export outcome is unchanged; no new check, flag or cache table
